title: Proteomics shows a J-type head is alpaca bone

tellings.quote: I ran these all of these bone samples from the skull through this pipeline and they all came back identified as alpaca bone.

plain: An anonymous expert in proteomics, the study of proteins that can identify which animal a bone came from, talks about the strange three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru. The expert says that every bone sample from the skull of one type of head, called J-type, came back as alpaca bone, pointing to published papers on identifying species from ancient bone and on scans showing alpaca-like brain cases. Told this way, at least that head would be made from an animal, not an unknown being.
